summary: iPortal D3C: native REGULAR produced content on the Phase-C spoken backend (My Content, shared recorder, existing spoken worker, ordinary library Tracks) and a TEST / NO AIR workspace whose media can never air (immutable ProductionMedia.airing_prohibited, inherited, refused by every air binding).
